content:
I guess this is also a challenge for me to write more challenges :-) Thanks for this! I have a much better idea of exactly what I will be needing for FLT and furthermore how to state it in Lean. I will still need to make some mathlib PRs before I can formalise some of the statements (in fact this is one of the bottlenecks -- missing definitions in mathlib) but I think it would be a very interesting idea if the community were to start filling them in.

FWIW I think Odlyzko is do-able and Mazur right now is a little out of reach because we are missing so many foundational definitions and API for them. There is ongoing work in Tau Ceti to try and get the elliptic curve and modular curve definitions up to speed.
A message was moved here from #Lean Pool > Announcements by Vasily Ilin.

The first challenge was solved in <24 hours. As @Kevin Buzzard pointed out, it's the easier of the two.
If anyone else has big standalone theorems they would like to pose as a challenge to formalize, please submit a challenge PR or message me your challenge statement.
Can you confirm that this solution did not use the recent proof of false which has spread like wildfire across many benchmarks? In other words, can you bump to 4.32.2?
